en.name: Sixtus III
en.summary: A pope who rebuilt the basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore following the Council of Ephesus's affirmation of Mary as Mother of God.
en.body: Sixtus III's reign followed closely on the Council of Ephesus's declaration of Mary as Theotokos, Mother of God, and he marked the occasion by rebuilding and richly decorating the basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore in Rome, whose mosaics remain among the finest surviving examples of early Christian art. He also worked to heal remaining rifts from the Pelagian and Nestorian controversies inherited from his predecessors.
